zeroBaseline: Percentage change is unavailable because the baseline is zero.
daysGate: Choose two different, resolved source-local days.
carGate: Comparison requires the same Karma car.
zoneGate: Comparison requires the same established source time-zone ID and name.
completionGate: Both report selections must be completely retrieved and complete or empty. Partial, open or unavailable selections are not comparable.
metricGate: This metric needs a complete numeric value on both days.
unitGate: The source units differ; no difference or percentage is calculated.
period: Source-local interval: {fromLocal} to {toLocal}, end exclusive. UTC interval: {fromUtc} to {toUtc}, end exclusive.
selectionRule: Whole trips are assigned to their source-local start day, including trips ending after midnight. The values use the report's exact loaded trip selection, not the current table page.
coverageRule: Retrieval completion does not establish every physical trip or continuous GPS coverage. Missing source values are not zero.
tripTimes: Trip source times, unchanged: {start} to {stop}. No UTC offset is inferred from these endpoint texts.
tripMetrics: Distance: {distance}; night distance: {nightDistance}, in unconfirmed source distance units. Maximum speed: {maxSpeed}, in unconfirmed source speed units.
positionsNotLoaded: No bounded position result is loaded. Only this trip's original endpoint metadata is available; no other truck position is substituted.
positionRead: Position retrieval: {retrieval} · reason {reason} · loaded rows {loaded}/{maxRows} · deadline {deadlineMs} ms · retrieved {retrievedAt}.
positionBoundaries: Requested message anchors: {startId} to {stopId}. Start present: {startPresent}; stop present: {stopPresent}; duplicate message IDs removed: {duplicates}.
positionClock: Sample clock: source edt in UTC. Ordering: {ordering}. Original source text is retained; physical position coverage is not assessed.
selectedPoint: Selected event {id}: source edt {sourceTime}; established UTC instant {instantUtc}; recorded speed {speed} and odometer {odometer}, both in unconfirmed source units.
selectedEndpoint: Selected trip {kind} endpoint: message {id}, original source time {sourceTime}. Its UTC instant is not established by the endpoint text.
selectedMissing: The selected key is absent from the loaded samples and this trip's endpoint records. No replacement point is selected.
